notes.title: play the JUICE Demo - my latest game :)
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=EsIOweJoxcE;full][/previewyoutube]


Hey all! Just released the demo for my latest project JUICE,  a hand-drawn first-person slaughterer that throws you into an apocalyptic dual narrative between a ravenous Monster and it's victim. It's quite a departure from my other titles usual genres but I highly recommend giving it a try anyways as it's something I'm quite proud of and the beginning of a hopefully whole new level of execution in future titles. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844430/Juice/]PLAY THE DEMO HERE, IT'S ONLY AVAILABLE TILL MONDAY OCTOBER 21st![/url]

notes.title: FICTION #F3F is now fiction.colors! 2 New Games :)
notes.notes:
Hey all!
Longtime :)

So first of all, if you hadn't noticed by the library and store name + art change, or header and subtitle of this post already: 

[h1]FICTION #F3F[/h1]
[h2]has been[/h2]
[h3]renamed[/h3]
to

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39187218/0e18abc5dd3e21cf0380fa83d457b51ed7631a62.png[/img]

[i]Woo! [/i]

[i]Why you ask? [/i]
yea [i]why?[/i]

Well tldr: [b]what was going to be a series is now a growing collection[/b]

Yes planned a short game collection series, named after hex codes, FICTION #F3F the first of many... But classic overscope moment there. Im tired haha, want an easy digital medium to share any cool weird small stuff, experiments or short games im working on. Let it grow over time.


that brought a new launcher! so [u]if you still see the pink fiction f3f launcher pls uninstall and reinstall the game![/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39187218/c87a14bf2927aa8d156e57e4f3a6c1a9e442b080.gif[/img]
this is the new launcher, again if you dont see this or you get an error pls reinstall game.

also

[h3]Two new Games!![/h3]


[b]*24 Jingles to Bell[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39187218/a1d87e4517b3b5a83e5c3d326a1adb8bc8b37eb9.gif[/img]
Explore a largeish open world as one of Santa's Reindeer in this goofy non horror short game about drunk driving made for the Haunted PS1 2021 Madvent calendar. With an amazing soundtrack composed by Jasmine Cooper, its good reminds me of Morrowind. 

[b]*Story of a Line[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39187218/d7016180778bdbab2b20257c344324945689052e.gif[/img]
A peaceful passive visual narrative about the story of a line making its way through a large world of lines. This was my second game, still holds up haha, made it after releasing dreamsim and while working on what would become 0n0w. It is randomly/procedurally generated so the lines journey is different every time.


Well, hope you all enjoy the new experiences, will be adding more in the future,
hope you're all well!

Best,
-Colorfiction
 <3
